title: Coast Guard Rescues 3 From Sinking Fishing Vessel Near Grays Harbor, Wash.
description:
The crew of a 47-foot Motor Life Boat from Coast Guard Station Grays Harbor rescues three fishermen from the sinking 74-foot vessel Privateer one mile outside of Grays Harbor, Wash. April 15, 2016. 

The crew of Privateer called station watchstanders via VHF radio, stating they were taking on water through an 8-to-12-inch hole, deploying their life raft and donning immersion suits preparing to abandon ship.

U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Astoria.
keywords: abandon ship, boat crew, immersion suit, Grays Harbor, privateer, search and rescue, Astoria, motor lifeboat
